pairs.en: Jabal Al-Qarah
pairs.zh: 卡拉山

pairs.en: A geological wonder
pairs.zh: 一处地质奇观

pairs.en: Caves that stay cool in summer and warm in winter, carved by time at the heart of the oasis.
pairs.zh: 绿洲深处，岁月凿出的洞穴——盛夏藏凉，寒冬存暖，是酷暑行程中清凉舒适的一站。

pairs.en: Jabal Al-Qarah rises from the middle of the oasis like an ancient guardian, but its secret lies not in its height — rather in its hollows. Caves and passages thread through its rock, keeping a gentle coolness at the peak of summer and a quiet warmth when night falls — a natural wonder that drew the people of Al-Ahsa to shelter here since antiquity.
pairs.zh: 卡拉山（Jabal Al-Qarah）自哈萨绿洲中央拔地而起，如一位远古的守望者；真正的秘密不在高度，而在山体内部：洞穴与通道在岩层中蜿蜒穿行，盛夏时节自有一份清凉，入夜之后又留有余温——正是这份天然的妙处，让当地居民自古便在此栖身。

pairs.en: Walk its narrow corridors, where the stone almost brushes your shoulders, then suddenly opens onto a high chamber pierced by a thread of light.
pairs.zh: 当您走进狭窄的石廊，两侧岩壁几乎触及肩头；转过一道弯，眼前豁然开朗，一线天光自石厅高处漏下，光影动人。

pairs.en: From the summit the oasis unfolds like a sea of palms — a view that sums up why Al-Ahsa became the largest palm oasis on earth.
pairs.zh: 登临山顶，绿洲铺展至天际，椰枣林连绵如海——一眼望去，便明白哈萨为何成为世界上最大的椰枣绿洲。

pairs.en: East of Hofuf — Al-Ahsa
pairs.zh: 胡富夫（Hofuf）以东——哈萨

pairs.en: Early morning or just before sunset, when the light softens and the heat eases.
pairs.zh: 清晨或傍晚日落前——光线转柔、暑气渐退的时刻，也最宜取景拍摄。

pairs.en: Al-Dibs Mosque
pairs.zh: 迪卜斯清真寺

pairs.en: The historic Al-Fatih Mosque — one of the Al-Koot district's oldest, built in the Ottoman era in 962 AH / 1555 CE.
pairs.zh: 迪卜斯清真寺，正式名称法提赫清真寺——库特区最古老的清真寺之一，建于奥斯曼时期的伊斯兰历 962 年（公元 1555 年）。

pairs.en: Al-Koot district — Hofuf
pairs.zh: 库特区——胡富夫

pairs.en: In the Al-Koot district of old Hofuf, bordered on the east by Qasr Ibrahim and a short walk from Al-Jabri Mosque and Bayt Al-Bay'ah, stands Al-Dibs Mosque.
pairs.zh: 在胡富夫老城的库特区，东侧紧邻易卜拉欣宫，距贾布里清真寺与效忠之家（拜特·拜阿）不过数步之遥，坐落着迪卜斯清真寺。

pairs.en: officially Al-Fatih Mosque, built in 962 AH / 1555 CE by the Ottoman governor Muhammad Farrukh Pasha
pairs.zh: 它的正式名称是法提赫清真寺，由奥斯曼总督穆罕默德·法鲁赫帕夏建于伊历 962 年（公元 1555 年）。

pairs.en: Its popular name comes from the date stores and dibs (date molasses) trade that once filled the street beside it.
pairs.zh: 人们习惯称它“迪卜斯”，是因为寺旁曾是椰枣市场与仓房，迪卜斯（椰枣糖浆）的买卖一度占满整条街。

pairs.en: Covering some 350 square metres, it follows the early Ottoman style, crowned by a large central dome ringed by smaller light-bearing domes.
pairs.zh: 全寺占地约 350 平方米，采用奥斯曼早期的形制：正中一座大穹顶，四周环绕着带采光口的小穹顶。

pairs.en: long served as a teaching mosque where Quran, fiqh and hadith were taught in the Shafi'i tradition
pairs.zh: 长久以来，它也兼作讲学的学堂，依沙斐仪学派讲授古兰经、教法与圣训。

pairs.en: Its eastern minaret was removed in 1391 AH / 1971 CE when Al-Koot street was opened, and after a partial collapse in 1406 AH / 1986 CE it was restored while preserving its old architectural character.
pairs.zh: 伊历 1391 年（公元 1971 年）开辟库特街时，东侧的宣礼塔随之拆除；伊历 1406 年（公元 1986 年）部分建筑坍塌，此后的修复保住了旧日风貌。

pairs.en: a working mosque to this day
pairs.zh: 时至今日，它仍是一座日常使用的清真寺。

pairs.en: Al Abi Bakr Al-Mulla Ribat
pairs.zh: 阿比·伯克尔·穆拉里巴特

pairs.en: The Al-Mulla family ribat — a scholarly endowment founded in 1280 AH to house students of knowledge, still active today.
pairs.zh: 穆拉家族的里巴特——伊斯兰历 1280 年（约公元 1863 年）设立的宗教捐产，专为求学者提供免费食宿，至今仍在使用。

pairs.en: Al-Ruwaidah quarter, Al-Koot district — Hofuf
pairs.zh: 库特区鲁维达街区——胡富夫

pairs.en: In the Ruwaidah quarter of Hofuf's Al-Koot district stands the Bubakr Ribat — properly the Ribat of the Al Abi Bakr Al-Mulla family.
pairs.zh: 在胡富夫库特区的鲁维达街区，坐落着阿比·伯克尔·穆拉家族里巴特（供求学者食宿的宗教学舍），当地人称之为布伯克尔里巴特。

pairs.en: a scholarly endowment founded in 1280 AH (around 1863 CE) by Sheikh Abdullah bin Abi Bakr Al-Mulla
pairs.zh: 它由谢赫阿卜杜拉·本·阿比·伯克尔·穆拉（“谢赫”是宗教学者的尊称）创建于伊历 1280 年（约公元 1863 年），是一处专为办学而设的瓦克夫（宗教捐产）。

pairs.en: For generations it has offered free lodging, food and drink to students of the Islamic sciences arriving from within Al-Ahsa and far beyond, as well as to travellers.
pairs.zh: 长期以来，学子从哈萨各地乃至更远的地方前来，在这里研习伊斯兰教的各门学问，食宿全部免费；过路的旅人也可借宿。

pairs.en: it has graduated generations of scholars and judges
pairs.zh: 这里还走出了一代又一代学者与法官。

pairs.en: Built of gypsum, gravel, timber and palm trunks, it rises in two storeys of rooms around an open courtyard lined with arcades, with an eastern wing holding a well and kitchens.
pairs.zh: 房舍以石膏、碎石、木材与椰枣树干筑成，居室分上下两层，环抱一座露天庭院，四周廊道相连；东侧设有水井与厨房。

pairs.en: Comprehensively restored in 1430 AH (around 2009 CE) while keeping its old character, it remains active to this day under the care of the Al-Mulla family — a witness to the depth of learning in the oasis.
pairs.zh: 伊历 1430 年（约公元 2009 年）经全面修复，旧日风貌得以留存。如今仍由穆拉家族照管，也仍在使用，是这片绿洲求学传统的见证。

pairs.en: Al-Qubba Mosque
pairs.zh: 库巴清真寺

pairs.en: The domed mosque inside Ibrahim Palace, one of its most striking architectural features.
pairs.zh: 库巴清真寺——易卜拉欣宫内那座带穹顶的清真寺，是宫中最引人注目的建筑之一。

pairs.en: Inside Qasr Ibrahim, Al-Koot district — Hofuf
pairs.zh: 库特区易卜拉欣宫内——胡富夫

pairs.en: Within the walls of Qasr Ibrahim in Hofuf's Al-Koot district stands the Qubba Mosque.
pairs.zh: 在胡富夫库特区，易卜拉欣宫的围墙之内，坐落着库巴（Al-Qubba）清真寺。

pairs.en: the palace's most striking architectural element and one of the defining images of heritage Al-Ahsa
pairs.zh: 它是这座宫殿最引人注目的建筑，也是哈萨传统风貌中最具代表性的一景。

pairs.en: It was founded in 979 AH / 1571 CE, after some five years of construction, as part of a complex that included a school of Islamic sciences and a place for teaching the Quran.
pairs.zh: 清真寺建成于伊斯兰历 979 年（公元 1571 年），前后建了约五年；当时这里是一片建筑群，另有一所讲授伊斯兰教法的学校和一处教授古兰经的地方。

pairs.en: It is crowned by a central hemispherical dome about thirteen metres across, flanked by small corner domes, with a free-standing cylindrical minaret rising nineteen metres around a stone spiral staircase.
pairs.zh: 正中是一座半球形穹顶，直径约 13 米，四角环列着小穹顶；旁边另有一座独立的圆柱形宣礼塔，高 19 米，塔内是石砌的螺旋楼梯。

pairs.en: Above its entrance, a gypsum plaque records the founding date in Thuluth script — a witness to an entire era of the oasis's history.
pairs.zh: 入口上方嵌有一方石膏铭板，上面用苏鲁斯体（Thuluth）写着建造年份，见证了绿洲历史上的一整个时代。

pairs.en: Al-Tahimiyah West Mosque
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚西清真寺

pairs.en: One of Al-Tahimiyah village's old mud mosques — its history awaiting confirmation.
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村留存至今的古老泥土清真寺之一——历史细节待确认（信息更新中）。

pairs.en: Al-Tahimiyah village — the eastern villages, Al-Ahsa
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村——哈萨东部村落

pairs.en: In the village of Al-Tahimiyah, among Al-Ahsa's eastern villages near Al-Qarah Mountain, this mosque is one of the surviving old mud-built mosques.
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村是哈萨东部村落之一，临近卡拉山。塔希米亚西清真寺便是村中留存至今的古老泥土清真寺之一。

pairs.en: a village once famed as 'the village of forty mosques', of which only around eleven remain
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚昔日素有“四十座清真寺之村”之称，如今仅存约 11 座。

pairs.en: Al-Tahimiyah's mosques are traditional structures of mud and palm trunks, and two of them — the East and West mosques — are listed in Al-Ahsa's official register of historic mosques.
pairs.zh: 村中的清真寺都是泥土与椰枣树干筑成的传统建筑，其中的东、西两座已列入哈萨历史清真寺官方名录。

pairs.en: The details of this particular mosque's founding date and builder are awaiting confirmation from documented sources.
pairs.zh: 至于它的始建年代与建造者，目前仍待确认（信息更新中）。

pairs.en: Al-Tahimiyah East Mosque
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚东清真寺

pairs.en: An old mud-built mosque in Al-Tahimiyah, the village once famed for its forty mosques.
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村的一座古老泥土清真寺——村子昔日以“四十座清真寺之村”闻名。

pairs.en: Al-Tahimiyah village — the eastern villages, Al-Ahsa
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村——哈萨东部村落

pairs.en: In the village of Al-Tahimiyah, among Al-Ahsa's eastern villages some twelve kilometres from Hofuf, stands the Al-Tahimiyah East Mosque.
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村是哈萨东部村落之一，距胡富夫约 12 公里。

pairs.en: also known as the First Tahimiyah Mosque, and in earlier times as Abu Al-Nu'ush Mosque, where funeral prayers were held before burial in the nearby cemetery
pairs.zh: 村中的塔希米亚东清真寺也称“塔希米亚第一清真寺”，早年还有“阿布·努乌什清真寺”之名，因为昔日的殡礼（为亡者举行的祈祷）都在这里举行，礼毕再送往邻近的墓地安葬。

pairs.en: Its history goes back centuries.
pairs.zh: 它的历史可上溯数百年。

pairs.en: It is a modest mud structure of three arcades around an inner courtyard, enclosed by an outer wall and roofed with palm trunks, holding about fifty worshippers.
pairs.zh: 这是一座朴素的泥土建筑：三道柱廊环抱内院，外有围墙，屋顶以椰枣树干铺就，可容纳约 50 名礼拜者。

pairs.en: built on the banks of the old Zuhairi stream with the slopes of Al-Qarah Mountain close by
pairs.zh: 它建在古老的祖海里河岸边，有几面紧挨着卡拉山的山坡。

pairs.en: In 2017 it was listed among Al-Ahsa's officially registered historic mosques.
pairs.zh: 2017 年，它入选哈萨历史清真寺官方名录。

pairs.en: its setting near Al-Qarah Mountain makes it an easy stop for visitors to the area
pairs.zh: 由于紧邻卡拉山，它也成了游客顺道探访的一站。

pairs.en: Al-Hubaish Mosque
pairs.zh: 胡拜什清真寺

pairs.en: A thirteenth-century AH mosque in southern Al-Rifaa that hosted the lessons of Sheikh Abdulaziz Al-Alji.
pairs.zh: 南里法阿区的一座清真寺，建于伊斯兰历 13 世纪（约公元 19 世纪），曾是谢赫阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·阿勒吉讲学的地方。

pairs.en: South Al-Rifaa district — central Hofuf
pairs.zh: 南里法阿区——胡富夫市中心

pairs.en: In the Al-Rifaa Al-Janubiyah district in central Hofuf stands Al-Hubaish Mosque, one of Al-Ahsa's oldest historic mosques, dating to the thirteenth century AH (around the nineteenth century CE).
pairs.zh: 胡富夫市中心的南里法阿区，坐落着哈萨最古老的历史清真寺之一——胡拜什清真寺，始建年代可上溯到伊历 13 世纪（约公元 19 世纪）。

pairs.en: It is also known as the Mosque of Sheikh Abdulaziz Al-Alji, after one of Al-Ahsa's leading scholars of fiqh and grammar whose lessons it hosted.
pairs.zh: 它还有一个名字，叫谢赫阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·阿勒吉清真寺（“谢赫”是宗教学者的尊称）。这位谢赫是哈萨著名的教法与阿拉伯语语法学者，当年正是在这座寺里讲学。

pairs.en: Built of limestone and mud and roofed with chandal wood, bamboo and woven mats
pairs.zh: 这座寺以石灰石和泥土砌筑，顶上铺着尚德尔木（一种用作屋顶椽木的木料）、竹竿与席子。

pairs.en: a total area of about 318 square metres holding some ninety worshippers
pairs.zh: 全寺占地约 318 平方米，可容纳约 90 人礼拜。

pairs.en: Rehabilitated in 2020 within the first phase of the Prince Mohammed bin Salman Project for the Development of Historic Mosques, it regained its life as a working mosque while keeping its original features.
pairs.zh: 2020 年，它在“穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼王子历史清真寺发展项目”第一阶段中完成修缮，既保留了旧日的模样，也重新成为一座日常使用的清真寺。

pairs.en: Umm Zurainiq Mosque
pairs.zh: 乌姆·祖赖尼格清真寺

pairs.en: A historic mosque in Al-Owaimriyah named after the adjoining cemetery, restored under the historic mosques project.
pairs.zh: 欧维姆里亚区的一座历史清真寺，名字取自相邻的旧墓地，已在“穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼王子历史清真寺发展项目”中完成修缮。

pairs.en: Al-Owaimriyah district — central Hofuf
pairs.zh: 欧维姆里亚区——胡富夫市中心

pairs.en: In the Owaimriyah district — one of the oldest quarters of central Hofuf — stands Umm Zurainiq Mosque, a small historic mosque more than a century old, named after the old cemetery beside it.
pairs.zh: 欧维姆里亚区是胡富夫市中心最古老的街区之一，乌姆·祖赖尼格清真寺就坐落在这里。这是一座不大的历史清真寺，建成已逾百年，寺名来自紧邻的那片旧墓地。

pairs.en: distinguished by its cylindrical minaret with a wooden balcony, a hallmark of the Eastern Province's mosque architecture
pairs.zh: 最有特色的是那座带木质阳台的圆柱形宣礼塔——这也是东部省清真寺建筑的标志性形制。

pairs.en: interior plaster ornament on its walls, windows and arches
pairs.zh: 室内的墙面、窗框与拱券上，还留着石膏雕饰。

pairs.en: expanding it from a mere thirty square metres to around 214, with room for some 94 worshippers — returning a working mosque to the neighbourhood
pairs.zh: 面积由原先的 30 平方米扩至约 214 平方米，可容纳约 94 人礼拜，重新成为社区里日常使用的清真寺。

pairs.en: Al-Uqair Port Mosque
pairs.zh: 乌盖尔港清真寺

pairs.en: The historic mosque within the Al-Uqair port complex, among the facilities developed under King Abdulaziz.
pairs.zh: 乌盖尔港历史建筑群中的清真寺，是阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王时期兴建与发展的港口设施之一。

pairs.en: Al-Uqair port — the Gulf coast east of Al-Ahsa
pairs.zh: 乌盖尔港——哈萨以东的海湾沿岸

pairs.en: On the Arabian Gulf coast east of Al-Ahsa, within the complex of the historic Al-Uqair port — the oldest seaport in Saudi Arabia — stands the port's historic mosque, where sailors, merchants and travellers once prayed at Najd's old gateway to the sea.
pairs.zh: 乌盖尔港（Al-Uqair）在哈萨以东的海湾沿岸，是沙特阿拉伯最古老的海港，也是纳季德（沙特中部地区）旧时通往大海的门户。乌盖尔港清真寺就立在这片历史建筑群之间，当年水手、商人和过路的旅人都在这里礼拜。

pairs.en: It is counted among the port facilities built and developed in the reign of King Abdulaziz, alongside the fort, the khan, the emirate building and the customs house, in the days when Al-Uqair was Al-Ahsa's commercial artery.
pairs.zh: 它和要塞、商队客栈、埃米尔府、海关楼一道，都是阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王时期兴建与发展起来的港口建筑。那时的乌盖尔港，正是哈萨的商贸命脉。

pairs.en: The mosque was restored under the historic mosques restoration programme, with the support of the Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu, among a group of Al-Ahsa's historic mosques.
pairs.zh: 后来，在朱拜勒与延布皇家委员会的支持下，它与哈萨的一批历史清真寺一同，依“历史清真寺修缮计划”完成了修复。

pairs.en: Today it stands within a site the Heritage Commission is comprehensively rehabilitating, part of the full story the old port tells its visitors.
pairs.zh: 如今，沙特遗产委员会正对它所在的整片遗址进行全面修缮。老港口讲给来访者的故事里，也少不了这座清真寺。

pairs.en: Sheikh Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Al-Mulla Mosque
pairs.zh: 谢赫穆罕默德·本·阿比·伯克尔·穆拉清真寺

pairs.en: A heritage mosque of some three centuries in the heart of the Al-Koot district, tied to the scholarly Al-Mulla family.
pairs.zh: 库特区中心一座约有三百年历史的传统清真寺，与阿比·伯克尔·穆拉学者家族渊源深厚。

pairs.en: Al-Koot district — Hofuf
pairs.zh: 库特区——胡富夫

pairs.en: In the heart of Hofuf's historic Al-Koot district, near the house and religious schools of the Al-Mulla family, stands the Mosque of Sheikh Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Al-Mulla — also known as the Eastern Mosque
pairs.zh: 谢赫穆罕默德·本·阿比·伯克尔·穆拉清真寺又称“东清真寺”（“谢赫”是宗教学者的尊称），就在胡富夫历史城区的库特区中心，距谢赫阿比·伯克尔宅邸与经学堂不远。

pairs.en: it long served as a centre of learning where lessons in fiqh, Quranic exegesis and grammar were held, its imams drawn generation after generation from the Al-Mulla scholarly family
pairs.zh: 长久以来，它也是一处讲学之地：教法、古兰经注与阿拉伯语语法的课程都在这里开设，领拜的伊玛目世代出自以学问传家的阿比·伯克尔·穆拉家族。

pairs.en: It was rehabilitated in the first phase of the Prince Mohammed bin Salman Project for the Development of Historic Mosques, completed in 1441 AH / 2020 CE, preserving its traditional character while accommodating around 125 worshippers.
pairs.zh: 它是“穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼王子历史清真寺发展项目”第一阶段的修缮对象之一，工程于伊斯兰历 1441 年（公元 2020 年）竣工。旧日的格局仍在，如今可容纳约 125 人礼拜。

pairs.en: Al-Shaban Mountain
pairs.zh: 舍巴安山

pairs.en: A free-standing rocky mountain near Al-Tuwaither known today as Al-Shaban — also called 'Aba Al-Kabari' — a name the old sources applied to Al-Qarah Mountain.
pairs.zh: 图韦希尔村附近一座孤立的岩石山，今天称作舍巴安山，当地人也叫它“阿巴·卡巴里”。而在古代文献里，“舍巴安”是卡拉山的名字。

pairs.en: Near Al-Tuwaither — east of Hofuf
pairs.zh: 图韦希尔村附近——胡富夫以东

pairs.en: The mountain known today as Al-Shaban is a rocky rise standing apart from Al-Qarah Mountain, near the village of Al-Tuwaither east of Hofuf, and it carries another local name: 'Aba Al-Kabari'.
pairs.zh: 今天所说的舍巴安山，是一座孤立的岩石山，与卡拉山各自独立，就在胡富夫以东的图韦希尔村附近。当地人还给它另一个名字——“阿巴·卡巴里”。

pairs.en: the geographer Yaqut al-Hamawi recorded it as 'a mountain in Bahrain [the historic eastern coastlands], in whose caves one seeks the cool'
pairs.zh: 地理学家雅古特·哈马维记有这样一条：“舍巴安：巴林的一座山，人们在它的洞中纳凉。”这里说的巴林，是历史上对这一带东部沿海地区的称谓。

pairs.en: it is said the name — 'the sated one' — came from the palms and waters that once encircled it
pairs.zh: 据说这个名字意为“饱足者”，因为昔日椰枣林与流水四面环绕着它。

pairs.en: As the name 'Al-Qarah' prevailed for that famous mountain, the name Al-Shaban settled on this neighbouring rise.
pairs.zh: 后来，那座名山因邻近的卡拉镇而通称“卡拉”，“舍巴安”之名便转而落在了旁边这座山上。

pairs.en: For the caves and visiting details of the famous mountain, see the Al-Qarah Mountain page.
pairs.zh: 至于那座名山的洞穴故事与游览详情，请见卡拉山一页。

pairs.en: A mountain massif north-east of the oasis, known in the history books as Kanzan — site of the 1915 Battle of Kanzan.
pairs.zh: 绿洲东北的一道山岭，史书里的名字是坎赞。公元 1915 年的坎赞战役就发生在这里。

pairs.en: On the eastern rim of the northern oasis, some fifteen kilometres north-east of Hofuf, stretches the massif of Kanzan Mountain — the name the history books know it by, though today it is commonly called Al-Shu'bah Mountain.
pairs.zh: 坎赞山横亘在北部绿洲的东缘，位于胡富夫东北方向约 15 公里处。史书里记下的名字是坎赞，今天人们更常叫它舒巴山。

pairs.en: A chain of sedimentary and sandy hills, it neighbours the villages of Al-Shu'bah, Al-Kilabiyah, Al-Battaliyah and Al-Jurn, and adjoins the surroundings of the ancient Jawatha Mosque on its western side.
pairs.zh: 这是一列由沉积岩与沙地构成的丘陵，与舒巴村、基拉比亚村、巴塔利亚村、朱尔恩村相邻，西侧接贾瓦塔清真寺古迹一带。

pairs.en: In the Kanzan area, in 1333 AH / 1915 CE, the famous Battle of Kanzan was fought in the era of King Abdulaziz, in which the King was wounded and his brother Prince Saad fell.
pairs.zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王时期，著名的坎赞战役于伊斯兰历 1333 年（公元 1915 年）在这一带打响，国王本人在此役中负伤，他的兄弟萨阿德王子阵亡。

pairs.en: Its clean, soft sands have made it a favourite spot for outings, dune driving and gazing over the palm groves, and Al-Ahsa Municipality is developing a major recreational park on the massif.
pairs.zh: 这里沙质细软洁净，是郊游、冲沙（沙丘越野驾驶）和远眺椰枣林海的热门去处，也很适合一家人同行。哈萨市政府正在这片山体上兴建一座大型休闲公园。

pairs.en: Four adjoining conical hills south-east of Hofuf, a favourite camping and desert-trip destination.
pairs.zh: 胡富夫东南四座相依的锥形山丘，是有名的露营与沙漠旅行去处。

pairs.en: Some 22 kilometres south-east of Hofuf, on the road heading towards Salwa and Qatar, rise the hills of Jabal Al-Arba — four adjoining conical formations of reddish sedimentary rock, thought to have once been a single hill split apart by erosion, which is how the mountain earned its name ('the Four').
pairs.zh: 出胡富夫向东南约 22 公里，在通往萨尔瓦与卡塔尔的公路旁，阿尔巴山拔地而起——四座相依的锥形山丘，由泛红的沉积岩构成。据推测，它们原本是一座山丘，在侵蚀作用下裂为四座。“阿尔巴”意为“四”，山名正由此而来。

pairs.en: The town of Al-Taraf lies about six kilometres to its north, and the mountain is one of southern Al-Ahsa's best-known spots for camping, desert trips and hiking.
pairs.zh: 塔拉夫镇就在山的北面，相距约 6 公里。这里是哈萨南部最有名的露营、沙漠旅行与徒步去处之一。

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa Municipality has launched a project to humanise the Jabal Al-Arba road, making the landmark easier to reach.
pairs.zh: 哈萨市政府已启动通往阿尔巴山的道路人性化改造工程，前往这处地标会更方便。

pairs.en: The first of Al-Ahsa's landmarks at its northern gateway, just west of Al-Oyoun city.
pairs.zh: 哈萨北部入口的第一处地标，就在欧尤恩市以西。

pairs.en: At Al-Ahsa's northern gateway, about a kilometre west of the city of Al-Oyoun, rises Al-Thulaim Mountain — the first landmark to greet travellers arriving at the oasis from the north.
pairs.zh: 从北面进入哈萨，最先映入眼帘的地标就是苏莱姆山，它立在欧尤恩市以西约 1 公里处。

pairs.en: It is a solitary rocky formation, one of the sedimentary desert hills scattered around the oasis's fringes.
pairs.zh: 这是一座孤立的岩石山，是散布在绿洲边缘的沙漠沉积丘陵之一。

pairs.en: Its position beside Al-Oyoun and the northern oasis road makes it an easy destination for desert outings and walking, and community proposals have been floated to develop it as a northern tourist gateway for Al-Ahsa — ideas that remain at the proposal stage.
pairs.zh: 它紧邻欧尤恩市区，又临绿洲北部的公路，无论是就近散步，还是往沙漠里走一段，都很方便。当地也有人提议把它开发成哈萨北部的旅游门户，这类想法目前仍停留在设想阶段。

pairs.en: A mountain of cool grottoes and rock formations north of Al-Tuwaither, amid the eastern villages.
pairs.zh: 图韦希尔村以北的一座山，洞中清凉，怪石嶙峋，就在哈萨东部的村落之间。

pairs.en: In the Al-Qou' quarter north of Al-Tuwaither village, amid the belt of Al-Ahsa's eastern villages some twenty kilometres east of Hofuf, rises Abu Husais Mountain, bordered on the west by the palm groves of Al-Tuwaither and Al-Qarah.
pairs.zh: 哈萨东部的村落连成一带，图韦希尔村以北的库厄区就在其中。阿布·胡赛斯山正立于此，在胡富夫以东约 20 公里处，西侧接图韦希尔村与卡拉镇的椰枣林。

pairs.en: The mountain is famed for its narrow grottoes, from which cool draughts flow year-round — a trait of Al-Ahsa's sedimentary hills — and for wind-carved rock formations and slopes easy enough for casual climbing.
pairs.zh: 这座山以狭窄的岩洞出名，洞里常年吹出凉风，这是哈萨沉积丘陵共有的特点。山上还有风蚀而成的岩石造型，坡势平缓，攀爬起来并不费力。

pairs.en: In 2024, Al-Ahsa Municipality signed an investment contract to develop and operate the mountain as a tourist resort with eco-friendly rural lodges over an area of 100,000 square metres.
pairs.zh: 2024 年，哈萨市政府签署了一份投资合同，将把这座山开发运营为一处占地 10 万平方米的旅游度假区，并配建生态友好型乡村旅舍。

pairs.en: One of the largest natural lakes in the Arabian Gulf, a reserve drawing migratory birds and nature lovers.
pairs.zh: 海湾地区最大的天然湖泊之一，也是一处保护区，候鸟在此栖息，自然爱好者慕名而来。

pairs.en: One of the largest natural lakes in the Arabian Gulf, and one of the twelve components inscribed as part of the Al-Ahsa Oasis site on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
pairs.zh: 阿斯法湖（黄湖）是海湾地区最大的天然湖泊之一，也随哈萨绿洲列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，是其十二处组成部分之一。

pairs.en: A rare expanse of water in the middle of the desert, it has become a haven for migratory birds and a destination for anyone seeking quiet and a wide horizon.
pairs.zh: 沙漠中央有这样一片水，本身就是难得的景象。如今它成了候鸟的栖息地，也是许多人寻找安静与开阔视野的去处。

pairs.en: The lake lies northeast of the oasis, and entry is free. Its finest hour is sunset, when the surface of the water takes on a golden light — the favourite time of photographers and nature lovers.
pairs.zh: 湖位于绿洲东北，参观免费。最美的时候在日落，水面浮起一层金光，摄影师与自然爱好者尤其偏爱这一刻。

pairs.en: At sunset, when the water glows and the flocks of birds return.
pairs.zh: 日落时分，水面泛起金光，成群的鸟儿陆续归来。
